chapter: Army service and after the war
title: Ending the postwar big band on the West Coast
summary: He broke up the new big band in California after a Leeds publishing check, because he was losing money on every date.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Well, the big band didn't last too long because -- I'll tell you what, bythe time we got to the West Coast from New York, by the time we got to the West Coast, I had seen the handwriting. And so I got my check from Decca Records -- well, it was from Leeds Publishing. And so I don't know, I guess I must have gotten a $3,000 or $4,000 check.
So I got all the guys together in the group and told them, I says, well, fellows, this is the end of it. Because I
was losing money right and left, right and left. It cost me to play dates.
